event.description: A Devcon 8 side event in Mumbai (BKC). It is separate from Devcon, so no Devcon ticket is needed. A networking dinner on queryable onchain data, prediction markets, agent infrastructure and onchain justice, co-hosted by Kleros with Arkiv Network (by Golem Network) and Web3 Mumbai. Programme (IST): doors open at 18:00, the three hosts give a welcome toast at 18:45, and at 19:00 Kleros and Arkiv hold a fireside chat, "Truth for Machines: Who keeps the record, who settles the dispute?", on how agents and markets share data, build identity and reputation, and resolve disputes. Dinner and open networking follow at 19:30, the results of the evening's prediction market are announced at 21:15, and the event closes at 22:00. Free to attend; the hosts approve registrations. Wei Wei Ooi is a Luma co-host.

event.recap: Facundo Trotz, Legal & Policy at Kleros, spoke on the panel 'Agent Commerce: The New Generation of Payments' in the AI x Blockchain Track by QVAC, with Vivek Chand (BSV Association), Sandro Knöpfel (Cardano Foundation) and Alberto Valero (Tether), moderated by Maxime Masuy (Mastercard). The panel covered machine-to-machine payments, who runs payments across cards, bank accounts and stablecoins, and how an agent proves who it acts for. Facundo Trotz focused on what happens after the payment, when an agent's purchase is disputed and someone has to decide: on the Agentic Commerce Court, AI agents run by independent stakers act as jurors, and human jurors can overturn the result on appeal.
